caption:
ChatGPT can now watch your credit score for you. Connect Experian in Finances and it tracks your VantageScore 3.0, updates monthly, and flags changes like a new account or inquiry.

US Plus and Pro only for now. Checking it is a soft inquiry, so it won't lower your score.

Not financial advice. Save this for the full breakdown.

📷 Photo: Village Global · CC BY 2.0 via Wikimedia Commons

#chatgpt #openai #ai #personalfinance #creditscore #fintech #aitools

slides.title: ChatGPT can now track your credit score.
slides.sub: Connect Experian in Finances to see your VantageScore 3.0, free with Plus or Pro.
slides.voiceover: ChatGPT can now track your Experian credit score for you.

slides.label: What launched
slides.title: Credit score in Finances
slides.voiceover: It shows your VantageScore 3.0, based on your Experian report.

slides.label: How to connect
slides.title: Set it up in Finances
steps: In ChatGPT on web, iOS or Android
slides.voiceover: Just open Finances, connect Experian, and it updates every month.

slides.label: What you can see
slides.title: More than just a number
items: About any factor behind your score
slides.voiceover: You can see balances, utilization, payment history, and every inquiry.

slides.label: Know the limits
slides.title: What the score can't tell you
items: VantageScore 3.0 is used by some lenders, not all
A lender may pull a different score than the one shown
Card balances reflect Experian's last reported figure, not live
ChatGPT can't file disputes or freeze your credit file
slides.cta: Follow for daily AI tool news
slides.voiceover: It's not the only score lenders use, so don't rely on it alone.

slides.label: By the numbers
slides.title: automatic score refresh
slides.sub: Checking it is a soft inquiry — it won't lower your score.
slides.voiceover: Checking your score is a soft inquiry, so it won't hurt you.

slides.label: Privacy
slides.title: You stay in control
items: Checking your score doesn't move it
slides.voiceover: Disconnect anytime, and your Experian data deletes within thirty days.

slides.title: ChatGPT now
lines: Finances → Experian, on US Plus or Pro
Checking it won't lower your score
slides.voiceover: That's ChatGPT's new credit tracker, live now for Plus and Pro.
